mapper.sql: select w.workstation_id, w.room_id, r.room_name, r.room_type, r.status room_status, r.mentor_id, mu.nick_name mentor_name, w.workstation_no, w.workstation_type, w.layout_row, w.layout_col, w.status, a.student_id, su.nick_name student_name from gw_workstation w left join gw_room r on r.room_id = w.room_id left join sys_user mu on mu.user_id = r.mentor_id left join gw_assignment a on a.workstation_id = w.workstation_id and a.ended_at is null left join sys_user su on su.user_id = a.student_id
mapper.insert: insert into gw_workstation(room_id, workstation_no, workstation_type, layout_row, layout_col, status, create_by, create_time) values(#{roomId}, #{workstationNo}, #{workstationType}, #{layoutRow}, #{layoutCol}, ifnull(#{status}, 'AVAILABLE'), #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update gw_workstation set room_id = #{roomId}, workstation_no = #{workstationNo}, workstation_type = #{workstationType}, layout_row = #{layoutRow}, layout_col = #{layoutCol}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where workstation_id = #{workstationId}
mapper.delete: delete from gw_workstation where workstation_id = #{workstationId} and status = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from gw_assignment where workstation_id=#{workstationId}) + (select count(1) from gw_return_application where workstation_id=#{workstationId} and status in ('PENDING_MENTOR','PENDING_ADMIN','WAIT_CLEAR','WAIT_VERIFY')) + (select count(1) from gw_inspection_record where workstation_id=#{workstationId})
select count(1) from gw_workstation where room_id=#{roomId} and workstation_no=#{workstationNo}
mapper.update: update gw_workstation set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where workstation_id = #{workstationId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from gw_workstation w join gw_room r on r.room_id=w.room_id where r.mentor_id=#{mentorId} and r.room_type='STUDIO' and r.status='NORMAL' and w.workstation_type='FIXED' and w.status='AVAILABLE'
